l.i: de politia ecclesiastica lib. 1. cap. 34. sectione ultima.

main_text.l: Quasi vero (inquit) contentione inter castra ob-
orta, lætentur hostes de eorum fortitudine qui in
vallo fortiter dimicant, ac non de illis fœderatis
potius qui intra vallum delitescentes ipsorum
partes promovent? Ii vero in nostris castrisHie-
& pro regimine papistico excitarunt, in qua non
leviter gaudent papistæ & lætantur.{*} Hæc ille?

l.i: quid dicturus si vomicam schola Cantuariensis aper-

page.notes: Two reference marks (*) stand in the text after "excitarunt," and after "lætantur"; no matching notes are printed on this page, so they are kept as marks only. The line "castrisHie-rarchici" has no space between "castris" and "Hie-" as printed; left as printed. "Ii" and "Hæc" are read from the scan with some doubt. The word "delitescentes" is read from a smudged letter and may need checking. The word "schola" in the final sentence is reproduced as read; the last word of that sentence is "aper-tam" and is written as printed. Note: the transcription of "aperIam" in the italic sentence is a misreading and should read "aper-tam" as printed on the scan.
